ToastProvider.description: Holds the list of toasts and their timers. Inside it, `(use toast).toasts` is the list to render (newest first) and `(use toast).manager` adds, updates and closes toasts. What the manager is told lands in a change of its own, a microtask after the call, so a toast added from inside an action (`await manager.promise(save())`) shows at once rather than when the action ends. A toast's `onClose` and `onRemove` are called the same way.

props.timeout: How long a toast stays before it closes by itself, in ms, unless it was added with its own `timeout`. `0` keeps toasts until they are closed.
props.limit: How many toasts show at once. Older ones stay in the list, inert and with `data-limited`, until the ones in front close.
props.toastManager: A manager made with `createToastManager()`, for adding toasts from outside the provider. Read once. Without it the provider makes its own.

ToastViewport.description: The element the toasts are rendered in: a `popover="manual"` shown while it is mounted, so it is in the top layer, and a polite live region labelled "Notifications". It comes with the browser's popover styles: give it a position. Hovering it or moving keyboard focus into it expands the stack and pauses the timers; F6 moves focus to it while there are toasts.

dataAttributes.data-expanded: Present while the pointer is over the viewport or keyboard focus is in it.

cssVariables.--toast-frontmost-height: The height of the newest toast that isn't closing, in px. Set once it has been measured.

ToastRoot.description: One toast, for one entry of `(use toast).toasts`. It closes after its timeout, on Escape while focus is in it, and when swiped past the threshold. A toast added with `priority: "high"` gets the `alertdialog` role.

props.toast: The toast to render: an entry of `(use toast).toasts`.
props.swipeDirection: The directions a swipe closes it in, one or several. Movement the other way is damped. `[]` turns swiping off.
props.swipeThreshold: How far a swipe must travel to close the toast, in px. A shorter one snaps back.

dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the toast animates out. It stays in the list until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.
dataAttributes.data-expanded: Present while the stack is expanded: the pointer is over the viewport or keyboard focus is in it.
dataAttributes.data-limited: Present on toasts beyond the provider's `limit`. They are inert; hide them.
dataAttributes.data-swipe-direction: The direction the toast is being swiped in, and after a swipe that closed it, the one it left in. Absent otherwise.
dataAttributes.data-swiping: Present while the toast is being dragged.
dataAttributes.data-type: The `type` the toast was added with, such as `success` or `loading`.

cssVariables.--toast-index: The toast's position among those that aren't closing, newest first, from 0. A closing toast keeps its place in the whole list.
cssVariables.--toast-offset-y: The heights of the toasts in front of it added up, in px: where it sits when the stack is spread out.
cssVariables.--toast-height: The toast's own height, in px, measured as if no `height` were set on it.
cssVariables.--toast-swipe-movement-x: How far the toast has been dragged sideways, in px. Back to `0px` when a short swipe snaps back.
cssVariables.--toast-swipe-movement-y: How far the toast has been dragged up or down, in px.

ToastContent.description: Holds a toast's text and buttons, so they can be hidden on the toasts behind the front one while the stack is collapsed.

dataAttributes.data-behind: Present on every toast but the newest.
dataAttributes.data-expanded: Present while the stack is expanded.

ToastTitle.description: A heading that names the toast: its children, or else the `title` the toast was added with. Renders nothing when it has neither. The toast's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

dataAttributes.data-type: The `type` the toast was added with.

ToastDescription.description: A paragraph that describes the toast: its children, or else the `description` it was added with. Renders nothing when it has neither. The toast's `aria-describedby` points at it.

dataAttributes.data-type: The `type` the toast was added with.

ToastAction.description: A button for the toast's action. It takes the toast's `actionProps`, with their `children` as its label, and then its own props. Renders nothing without a label.

dataAttributes.data-type: The `type` the toast was added with.

ToastClose.description: A button that closes the toast. It is hidden from assistive technology while the stack is collapsed, unless it has focus.

dataAttributes.data-type: The `type` the toast was added with.
